assets.description:
The assets that would need to be upserted to instantiate the {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} used to call
`makeHierarchy`.

relations.description:
The relations that would need to be upserted to instantiate the {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} used to call
`makeHierarchy`. This includes the relations to the `parent` that `makeHierarchy` was called with.

facilityRelations.description:
The facility relations that would need to be upserted to instantiate the {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate}
used to call `makeHierarchy`.
